_comment: The 9 swegemma tools with the exact signatures published in the competition's HARNESS_README.md and Overview (Gemma 4 Developer Agent Competition, Sep 2026).

tools.name: run_command
tools.description: Execute a shell command in /bin/bash -c inside /workspace. 300 s timeout; stdout/stderr truncated to 5000 characters.

tools.name: submit_patch
tools.description: Stage untracked file intents (git add -N .) and capture git diff HEAD from /workspace. Call last; ends the session.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Return live budget consumption and patch status.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a file from /workspace with 1-indexed inclusive line slicing (max 150 lines / 10000 characters per call).

tools.name: edit_file
tools.description: Replace old_string with new_string in an existing non-empty file inside /workspace.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Create or overwrite a file at /workspace/<filepath>, creating parent directories.

tools.name: get_code_neighbors
tools.description: Find incoming and outgoing neighbors of a symbol in the repository call/dependency graph.

tools.name: search_similar_code
tools.description: Find the top-k graph nodes most similar to a symbol name using the pre-computed embeddings.

tools.name: get_code_subgraph
tools.description: Extract the induced subgraph (nodes and interconnecting edges) for a list of symbols.
